items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: So Thelonious got this last minute booking in San Francisco and so they were looking for a bass player and I got recommended by several people who knew I knew his stuff.

ctx.x: Was it apparent on the gig — did he show pleasure or otherwise with the way the band was sounding? Could you tell if he was pleased or not?

Oh yeah. No I was called to work a week — two weeks in San Francisco. And in the middle of the second week he had — and I hung out with him every minute, I mean, and he wasn’t strange, you know like they always picture him as a weirdo, he’s not weird. Not at all. You know and he’s not effusive. He’d go sometimes a couple of days and not say anything at all, but if you’re not afraid of large black men, you know, all you have to do is be around a few and you realize hey man, like I think that, you know this is my…
That’s a great way to put it.
